title: State-Specific Laws and Legal Information — India

specific_laws.name: Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) 1999
specific_laws.description: Targets organised crime syndicates. Provides for harsher punishments, special courts, interception of communications, and prolonged pre-trial detention. Admissibility of confessions to police officers (unlike IPC).

specific_laws.name: Maharashtra Rent Control Act 1999
specific_laws.description: Regulates tenancy in Maharashtra. Protects tenants from arbitrary eviction; recognises pagdi system; standard rent concept.

specific_laws.name: Maharashtra Slum Areas (Improvement, Clearance and Redevelopment) Act 1971
specific_laws.description: Governs slum redevelopment, especially in Mumbai. SRA (Slum Rehabilitation Authority) oversees rehabilitation projects.

specific_laws.name: Maharashtra Land Revenue Code 1966
specific_laws.description: Governs land records, mutation, surveys, and land administration in Maharashtra. Administered by Revenue Department.

specific_laws.name: Maharashtra Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act (MPDA) 1981
specific_laws.description: Preventive detention law targeting dangerous individuals involved in organised crime, bootlegging, anti-social activities.

specific_laws.name: Mumbai Municipal Corporation Act 1888
specific_laws.description: Governs municipal administration in Mumbai, including building regulations, property tax, and civic amenities.

legal_aid.district_body: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in each district
legal_aid.eligibility: Annual income below ₹3 lakh; SC/ST/women/children/persons with disability/victims of trafficking

specific_laws.name: Karnataka Land Reforms Act 1961
specific_laws.description: Regulates ceiling on agricultural land holding; vests surplus land in state for distribution to landless agriculturists. Tenancy of agricultural lands regulated.

specific_laws.name: Karnataka Apartment Ownership Act 1972
specific_laws.description: Governs ownership of apartments in Karnataka; registration of apartment associations; rights and duties of apartment owners.

specific_laws.name: Karnataka Prevention of Slaughter and Preservation of Animals Act 1964
specific_laws.description: Regulates slaughter of cattle in Karnataka.

specific_laws.name: Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act 1961
specific_laws.description: Regulates working conditions in shops and establishments — working hours, leave, holidays, employment terms.

specific_laws.name: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) Act 2020
specific_laws.description: Governs Bengaluru's metropolitan municipality. Revised to give greater autonomy to ward committees.

specific_laws.name: Karnataka Prohibition of Slums Act 1973
specific_laws.description: Prohibition and clearance of slums in Karnataka.

legal_aid.eligibility: Annual income below ₹3 lakh; SC/ST/women/children/persons with disability

specific_laws.name: Delhi Rent Control Act 1958
specific_laws.description: Governs rent of premises where monthly rent does not exceed ₹3,500. Tenants have strong eviction protection; landlord can evict only on specified grounds.

specific_laws.name: Delhi Development Act 1957
specific_laws.description: Governs planned development of Delhi. Delhi Development Authority (DDA) constituted under this Act.

specific_laws.name: Delhi Land Reforms Act 1954
specific_laws.description: Governs agricultural tenancy and land reforms in Delhi's rural belt.

specific_laws.name: Delhi Prevention of Defacement of Property Act 1976
specific_laws.description: Prohibits and penalises defacement of public and private property through writing, poster pasting, graffiti.

specific_laws.name: Delhi Preservation of Trees Act 1994
specific_laws.description: Regulates felling of trees in Delhi; permission required from Tree Officer for felling any tree.

legal_aid.eligibility: Annual income below ₹3 lakh; SC/ST/women/children/persons with disability; victims of trafficking

specific_laws.name: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act 2017
specific_laws.description: Modern tenancy law replacing old Rent Control Act for new tenancies. Mandatory registration of tenancy agreements.

specific_laws.name: Tamil Nadu Land Reforms (Fixation of Ceiling on Land) Act 1961
specific_laws.description: Fixes ceiling on agricultural land holdings and vests surplus land in state.

specific_laws.name: Tamil Nadu Prohibition Act 1948
specific_laws.description: Governs prohibition and regulation of alcohol in Tamil Nadu. Tasmac holds monopoly on liquor sales.

specific_laws.name: Tamil Nadu Panchayats Act 1994
specific_laws.description: Governs rural local self-governance in Tamil Nadu.

specific_laws.name: Tamil Nadu Protection of Interests of Depositors (in Financial Establishments) Act 1997
specific_laws.description: Protects depositors in chit funds and financial companies; attachment of property.
key_provisions: Attachment of chit fund promoter property

legal_aid.authority: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority (TNSLSA)

specific_laws.name: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act 1986
specific_laws.description: Preventive detention law for persons indulging in dangerous activities including bootlegging, goonda activity.

specific_laws.name: Telangana Land Revenue Act 1317 Fasli (as adapted)
specific_laws.description: Governs land records, passbook system, mutation in Telangana.

specific_laws.name: Telangana Apartments (Promotion of Construction and Ownership) Act 1987
specific_laws.description: Governs apartment ownership and association in Telangana.

specific_laws.name: Telangana Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act (State rules)
specific_laws.description: State rules implementing the central SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act with district vigilance committees.

legal_aid.eligibility: Annual income below ₹3 lakh; SC/ST/women/children/persons with disability

specific_laws.name: Andhra Pradesh Land Reforms (Ceiling on Agricultural Holdings) Act 1973
specific_laws.description: Fixes ceiling on agricultural land; surplus land redistributed to landless poor.

specific_laws.name: Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition on Transfers) Act 1977
specific_laws.description: Prohibits transfer of government-assigned lands to non-eligible persons.

specific_laws.name: AP Capital Region Development Authority Act 2014
specific_laws.description: Created CRDA for development of new capital region; land pooling scheme.

legal_aid.authority: Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority (APSLSA)
legal_aid.eligibility: Annual income below ₹3 lakh; SC/ST/women/children/persons with disability

specific_laws.name: Gujarat Prohibition Act 1949
specific_laws.description: Gujarat is a prohibition state. Manufacture, sale, and consumption of alcohol prohibited; permits required for medicinal use.

specific_laws.name: Gujarat Land Revenue Code 1879
specific_laws.description: Governs land administration, revenue records (Form 6 — Hak Patrak / 7/12), mutation.

specific_laws.name: Gujarat Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act 1948
specific_laws.description: Governs agricultural tenancy; purchase rights of tenants.

specific_laws.name: Gujarat Local Authorities Laws (Amendment) Act 2009
specific_laws.description: Amendments to municipal laws for better urban governance.

legal_aid.eligibility: Annual income below ₹3 lakh; SC/ST/women/children/persons with disability

specific_laws.name: Rajasthan Tenancy Act 1955
specific_laws.description: Governs agricultural tenancy, rights of Khatedar tenants, and sub-tenancy in Rajasthan.

specific_laws.name: Rajasthan Land Revenue Act 1956
specific_laws.description: Governs land revenue administration, land records (Jamabandi / Khasra), mutation, revenue courts.

specific_laws.name: Rajasthan Public Safety Act 2011
specific_laws.description: Preventive detention of persons indulging in anti-social activities.

specific_laws.name: Rajasthan Control of Organised Crime Act 2016
specific_laws.description: Targets organised crime in Rajasthan. Special courts and harsher punishments.
